**MVPAlab** is a MATLAB toolbox for decoding analyses of **multidimensional electroencephalography (EEG) data** based on machine learning. It implements multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) and multivariate cross-classification, and it comes with a graphical user interface for users with little coding experience, as well as high- and low-level routines for those who want to build their own projects.

[{{< fa download >}} Download](https://github.com/dlopezg/mvpalab){.btn .btn-primary .btn role="button" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Download the toolbox"}

# Features

- Multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) and multivariate cross-classification.
- Temporal generalization matrices.
- Feature and frequency contribution analyses.
- Configurable analysis: trial averaging, balanced datasets, normalization, smoothing, channel selection, dimensionality reduction, classification models, cross-validation, performance metrics and parallel computation.
- Cluster-based permutation testing.
- Graphical user interface and tools to plot the results.
- Demo scripts and a sample EEG dataset.

MVPAlab is released as open source under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

# Reference

D. López-García, J. M. G. Peñalver, J. M. Górriz and M. Ruz. *MVPAlab: A machine learning decoding toolbox for multidimensional electroencephalography data*. **Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine**, 214, 106549 (2022). DOI: [10.1016/j.cmpb.2021.106549](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cmpb.2021.106549)
